profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc is a Toronto-based public company, traded under the ticker CLS, that describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions. According to its own site, it engineers, designs and manufactures what it calls the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud and hybrid cloud while advancing technologies in high-growth markets. The company says it serves customers through a global network and helps them achieve a competitive advantage.

The site positions AI and cloud infrastructure as central to the business, though no specific AI products are named in the material available. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or product listings are recorded for the company. Its SEC filing record is present under CIK 0001030894.
